Callout.Name: Fight in the Street
Callout.Message: Two groups fighting in the street.
Callout.Advisory: Six or more involved, bottles seen.

Script.Line: It is between the two of us. It has nothing to do with you.
He has got a bottle. Look at his hand, he has got a bottle.
Everybody here will tell you the same thing.

Lines.Approach: Six of them at least, and bottles. Wait for your back-up if you can.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
